device.description: 16-bit 2.5 MSPS fully differential SAR ADC with enhanced-SPI interface
device.note: ads9120.pdf (SBAS710B) p.3 pin functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions, p.6 power-supply requirements (DVDD 1.65-1.95 V), p.7 timing (conversion cycle, reset, SPI interface), p.20 transfer function (twos complement), p.22 RST state, p.24-25 commands and output data word, p.27 data transfer frame, p.44-47 register map, p.58 PD mode unlock

registers.name: PD_CNTL
registers.note: p.45 Table 6-9: writes must be preceded by writing 69h to address 011h

registers.name: PD_KEY
registers.note: internal (model state): set by the 69h-to-011h unlock write, p.45 / p.58

commands.name: WR_REG (unlock PD_CNTL)
commands.note: p.45, p.58: write 69h to address 011h to unlock PD_CNTL

commands.name: WR_REG (PD_CNTL, PDWN = 1)
commands.note: p.58: PD mode entered at the CS rising edge

commands.name: WR_REG (PD_CNTL, locked)
commands.note: p.45: PD_CNTL writes without the unlock write are ignored

commands.name: RD_REG
commands.note: p.24 Table 6-2; p.24: D[19:12] of the next frame are the register, D[11:0] zeros

pages: p.3 (pins), p.4 (ROC, nominal 1.8 V only), p.6 (supply ranges AVDD/DVDD 1.65-1.95 V), p.7 (timing), p.20 (transfer function), p.22 (RST), p.24-25 (commands, output data word, parity), p.27 (frame), p.34-35 (SPI protocols), p.44-47 (registers), p.58 (PD mode)
notModeled: analog input and reference; the result is always the 0 V differential code 0000h (twos complement)
20-bit command word decoded from the last 20 SDI bits before CS rises (align end); frames shorter than 20 SCLKs are NOPs (p.27)

SPI protocol selection: SDI_MODE (SPI-01/10/11), SDO_MODE source-synchronous output with RVS as strobe, SDO_WIDTH dual/quad SDO, DATA_RATE (DDR), SSYNC_CLK_SEL: stored only; the bus stays SPI-00-S on SDO-0 (SDO-1..3 never driven)
parity bits FLPAR/FTPAR (PAR_EN, FPAR_LOC): stored only; the parity positions output 0, correct for the 0 V code and all four fixed patterns but not for register read-back

PD_CNTL key: the 69h-to-011h unlock is modeled as a latched state (once unlocked, later PD_CNTL writes are accepted); the datasheet does not say whether the key is consumed by one write. A read of address 011h returns 0
NAP mode (NAP_EN) stored only; power-up time tPWRUP 250 us, NAP wake-up 300 ns, RST-to-RVS delay td_rst 1250 us
RVS while CS is low and the td_CSRDY_r delay after CS rise: not modeled; RVS is low while converting
conversion time varies 270-290 ns (modeled: 290 ns max); cycle time, acquisition and quiet-zone timing, SCLK frequency limit 75 MHz
reserved command codes: treated as NOP (unmatched)
variants: ads9120.pdf covers the ADS9120 only (the ADS9110 is the pin-compatible 18-bit 2 MSPS variant with its own datasheet).
